title: Junior Olympics & Field Sports Day
summary: A high-energy morning of mini hurdles, beanbag relays, parachute waves, and medal ceremonies emphasizing teamwork, motor skills, and sportsmanship.
description: Every child is a champion at Star Kids! Our Junior Olympics celebrates healthy physical movement, coordination, and team spirit through fun-filled, non-competitive games designed by our early childhood physical education coaches.

schedule.details: Every participant receives their Star Ribbon!
